title: Member help still describes the old first screen and the old erase, and says nothing about phone number sign-in
what: The help article for joining a gym tells a new member to tap Join my gym on the first screen. The first screen now shows only Continue with your phone number and a Try another way link, and no member article explains signing in with your phone number at all. The erase article says only that Erase all data deletes everything on this phone, though a signed-in member now chooses between this phone only and deleting the MettleUp account too. No article covers the screen shown when the app cannot start. The AI help answers only from these articles, so it gives the old steps.
expected: Member help explains the phone number sign-in and Try another way, the two erase choices, and what to do on the start-up error screen.
how_often: every time a member asks help about getting in or erasing
fix_line: Update the join and erase articles and add one for phone number sign-in and the start-up error screen

title: When the app cannot open a member's data, MettleUp is never told
what: If the app fails at start-up (its data will not open, update or read), the member sees the start-up error screen. That failure is only written to the phone's own log. The crash reports that reach MettleUp are sent only for a full crash or a screen that crashed, so a member locked out of their workouts this way is invisible to MettleUp unless they find someone to tell.
expected: A start-up failure sends one crash report (without workout data) so MettleUp sees it the same day, as it does for screen crashes.
who: members whose app will not open
how_often: rare, but each one is a locked-out member
fix_line: Send a crash report when the start-up error screen is shown

title: If MettleUp's WhatsApp check line stops working, every new member is stuck in a Start again loop and MettleUp is not told
what: The main way into the app is now Continue with your phone number, which depends on one MettleUp WhatsApp number receiving the member's message. If that line stops receiving (account blocked, token expired, number lost with the laptop or phone), the waiting screen only offers Open WhatsApp and Start again, and ends with 'The check ran out of time. Tap Start again.' It never suggests Try another way or the gym code, and nothing tells MettleUp that checks are failing.
expected: After a check runs out of time, the screen offers the gym code and Try another way, and repeated failed checks alert MettleUp.
who: every new member using phone sign-in
how_often: whenever the WhatsApp line is down
fix_line: Offer the other ways in after a timed-out check and alert MettleUp when checks keep timing out
